description.value:
A fortune-teller once confided in you that your destiny is far greater than that of your peers, and everything you've experienced since that moment seems to confirm it. You'd never go so far as to say you're better than everyone else, but it's certainly true that others often look to you for guidance and rely on your initiative and leadership skills. Things have a way of working out for you, and you're starting to believe it might not just be luck. You've got a purpose. It's just time to figure out what that purpose is...

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Charisma or Strength, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Society skill and in the Aroden Lore skill, as he's been a role model to you. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Multilingual] skill feat and can select Azlanti as one of your new languages.
